name: daylight-basement-world
comment: A world-only plate for the basement-bull trailer: the exact log scene of the picked character frame with nobody in it, so the light and the set can be a reference without a face (fal's checker rejected the character still as a possible real-person likeness).
subject: Live-action documentary realism, a frame from a film shot on a full-frame cinema camera with a 35 mm lens: a dense pine forest at late golden hour, the low sun flaring between the trunks from behind and to the left, a faint glimpse of snow-capped mountains between the trees, dust and pollen in the light, fine film grain, true-to-life colour. No people, no text, no logos.
negative: people, person, man, figure, text, letters, logos, cartoon, illustration, CGI look

styles.label: the same log scene, nobody there
styles.style: EXACTLY the scene of the reference image with the person removed: the same fallen log across the frame, the same trees and light, the matte black energy drink can with a plain green stripe standing alone on the log where he sat, pine needles on the ground; nobody in the frame.
